scope: Local production-method tests, DOM fixtures, source dependency inspection and native EGL. No browser FPS or user-device input latency measurement.

checks.note: Overlaps receiver checks in focused suite; do not sum as unique tests.

initialCode.method: ESM lexer follows literal static imports/re-exports from public/app.js; dynamic imports, workers, CSS, framework bootstrap and data fetches excluded. gzipBytes sums per-file gzip level 9, a transport-size estimate rather than measured wire traffic.

tradeoffs: Resident fallback follows the exact current plane but has coarser measured source resolution than Ultra.
The same display transfer and output size do not make coarse/fine source pixels identical.

Bounded physical decoding increases final exact Ultra delivery in the fixed 40 ms service fixture from 40 ms to 56–72 ms; it reduces work pressure, while immediate resident display removes the old holding delay.
dataCompatibility: No scan source asset or encoded image URL/cache key changed.
